name: create_order
title: Create order
description: Creates a new checkout order specifying details such as amount, currency, items, and payment intent. Use this when initiating a purchase session for a customer.

name: confirm_payment_source
title: Confirm Payment Source
description: Confirms the buyer's intended payment source, such as a credit card or PayPal account, for an order. Use this when establishing the payment method before authorization or capture.
example_questions: Confirm card details as the payment source for order ORD-55412.
Set the payment source for order 9AB87654CD to PayPal balance.
Attach the credit card payment source to order 7765123.

name: show_order_details
title: Show order details
description: Retrieves comprehensive details about a specific order, including line items, totals, payment status, and buyer information. Use this to check the current state of an order by its ID.
example_questions: Show me the details for order ORD-88392.
What is the current status of order 5O1982346?
Can you look up order 9AB87654CD?
Check the order items and shipping details for ORD-1002.

name: update_order
title: Update order
description: Modifies uncompleted order attributes such as shipping address, purchase amounts, invoice ID, or line items. Use this when an existing created or approved order requires updates.
example_questions: Update the shipping address on order ORD-99211.
Change the total purchase amount for order 4XX91823 to $120.00.
Add a soft descriptor to order ORD-3032.
Modify the invoice ID on order 88234101.

name: authorize_payment_for_order
title: Authorize payment for order
description: Authorizes funds for an approved order without immediately capturing them. Use this to hold or reserve funds on the buyer's payment source for future capture.
example_questions: Authorize the payment for order ORD-44120.
Reserve funds on order 8AB12345CD.
Can you authorize payment on order ORD-7821?
Perform payment authorization for checkout order 91028374.

name: capture_payment_for_order
title: Capture payment for order
description: Captures payment for an approved order to finalize the transaction and collect funds. Use this when ready to process and complete payment collection from the buyer.
example_questions: Capture the payment for order ORD-55412.
Collect funds for order 8AB12345CD.
Process the final payment capture on order ORD-9901.
Capture funds for checkout order 3349182.

name: confirm_payment_source_3ds
title: Confirm Payment Source - 3DS
description: Confirms a payment source requiring 3D Secure authentication for an order. Use this when card payments require explicit 3DS security verification during checkout.
example_questions: Confirm card payment source with 3D Secure verification for order ORD-7721.
Submit 3DS payment source confirmation for order 9AB87654CD.
Process 3D Secure confirmation on order ORD-1209.
Verify card payment source using 3DS for order 5543189.

name: add_tracking_information_for_an_order
title: Add tracking information for an order
description: Attaches shipment tracking information, such as carrier name and tracking number, to an order. Use this after order fulfillment to provide shipment tracking to the buyer.
example_questions: Add tracking number 1Z9999999999999999 for FedEx to order ORD-3301.
Attach UPS tracking info to order 8AB12345CD.
Add USPS tracking code 9400100000000000000000 to order ORD-8812.
Upload shipping details for order 5521908.

name: update_tracking_information_for_an_order
title: Update tracking information for an order
description: Updates or cancels existing shipment tracking details for a specific tracker on an order. Use this when shipment details or tracking numbers need modification or cancellation.
example_questions: Update tracking details for tracker TRK-9912 on order ORD-3301.
Change carrier to DHL for tracker TRK-4410 on order 8AB12345CD.
Cancel tracking information TRK-8812 on order ORD-8812.
Modify tracking number for tracker TRK-5511 on order 120984.

name: show_details_for_authorized_payment
title: Show details for authorized payment
description: Retrieves the status, amount, and expiration date of a temporary hold or pre-approved payment. Use this to check if funds are frozen on a card but not yet charged.

authorization_id.description: The ID of the authorized payment for which to show details.

example_questions: Can you check if the $50 hold on order #8932 is still active?
Is authorization auth-99201 still pending or did it expire?
Show me the status of the funds we blocked for customer Sarah Jenkins yesterday.
I want to see the details of the card reservation ID 77291A.

name: reauthorize_authorized_payment
title: Reauthorize authorized payment
description: Extends the validity period of a previously frozen hold to ensure the funds remain secured for processing. Use this if the initial 3-day window has expired but you still need to capture the money later.

authorization_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the authorized payment to reauthorize.

example_questions: The hold on authorization 88201B is about to expire, can you renew it?
Extend the payment hold for order 99281 so we don't lose the secured funds.
Re-verify the blocked funds of $120.00 under hold ID auth-3321A.
Can we stretch the expiration date on the reservation for transaction 40921?

name: void_authorized_payment
title: Void authorized payment
description: Releases a temporary hold on a customer's funds, canceling the pending transaction before any money is actually transferred. Use this when an order is canceled before fulfillment.

authorization_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the authorized payment to void.

example_questions: Cancel the card hold for transaction auth-99012 because the buyer changed their mind.
Release the frozen $45.00 on booking #5521 right away.
Can you cancel the authorization block with ID 883012?
The customer canceled their order, so please unlock their pending funds from auth-7128A.

name: capture_authorized_payment
title: Capture authorized payment
description: Finalizes a pre-approved transaction by actually withdrawing the frozen funds from the customer's account. Use this when shipping an order or completing a service.

authorization_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the authorized payment to capture.

example_request_body.note_to_payer: If the ordered color is not available, we will substitute with a different color free of charge.

example_questions: Charge the customer the $89.00 we previously held under authorization 99201B.
Collect the cash for hold ID 11203A now that the goods have shipped.
Can we process the final payment on the reserved funds for transaction 48122?
Go ahead and secure the payment of $150.00 from the authorized hold auth-7762A.

name: show_captured_payment_details
title: Show captured payment details
description: Displays the specific transaction details of a completed charge, including fees, net amount, and settlement status. Use this to review successful charges.

capture_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the captured payment for which to show details.

example_questions: I need to see the transaction details for charge ID cap-881290.
Did the payment of $200 with capture ID 102938 go through successfully?
Show me the processing fee and net payout for the charge 773192B.
Is transaction ID cap-55102 fully settled yet?

name: refund_captured_payment
title: Refund captured payment
description: Returns some or all of a previously settled payment back to the customer's original funding source. Use this to handle returns, cancellations, or billing adjustments.

capture_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the captured payment to refund.

example_questions: Send back $45.00 to the customer for charge ID cap-90123.
The buyer returned the shoes, so issue a full refund on payment 882019.
Give a partial credit of $20 to transaction cap-77123 because the box was damaged.

name: show_refund_details
title: Show refund details
description: Checks the status, amount, and dates of a money return transaction. Use this to verify if a customer's refund has been processed or is still pending.

refund_id.description: The PayPal-generated ID for the refund for which to show details.

example_questions: Can you check if refund transaction ref-99012 has cleared yet?

total_required.description: Indicates whether the to show total_pages and total_items in the response.

name: list_transactions
title: List transactions
description: Retrieves a list of past transactions, sales, and payments with options to filter by date, amount, status, or currency. Use this to audit account activity or locate specific past payments.

fields.description: Indicates which fields appear in the response. Value is a single field or a comma-separated list of fields. The transaction_info value returns only the transaction details in the response. To include all fields in the response, specify fields=all. Valid fields are:transaction_info. The transaction information. Includes the ID of the PayPal account of the payee, the PayPal-generated transaction ID, the PayPal-generated base ID, the PayPal reference ID type, the transaction event code, the date and time when the transaction was initiated and was last updated, the transaction amounts including the PayPal fee, any discounts, insurance, the transaction status, and other information about the transaction.payer_info. The payer information. Includes the PayPal customer account ID and the payer's email address, primary phone number, name, country code, address, and whether the payer is verified or unverified.shipping_info. The shipping information. Includes the recipient's name, the shipping method for this order, the shipping address for this order, and the secondary address associated with this order.auction_info. The auction information. Includes the name of the auction site, the auction site URL, the ID of the customer who makes the purchase in the auction, and the date and time when the auction closes.cart_info. The cart information. Includes an array of item details, whether the item amount or the shipping amount already includes tax, and the ID of the invoice for PayPal-generated invoices.incentive_info. An array of incentive detail objects. Each object includes the incentive, such as a special offer or coupon, the incentive amount, and the incentive program code that identifies a merchant loyalty or incentive program.store_info. The store information. Includes the ID of the merchant store and the terminal ID for the checkout stand in the merchant store.

start_date.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a start date and time, in Internet date and time format. Seconds are required. Fractional seconds are optional.

end_date.description: Filters the transactions in the response by an end date and time, in Internet date and time format. Seconds are required. Fractional seconds are optional. The maximum supported range is 31 days.

transaction_id.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a PayPal transaction ID. A valid transaction ID is 17 characters long, except for an order ID, which is 19 characters long.Note: A transaction ID is not unique in the reporting system. The response can list two transactions with the same ID. One transaction can be balance affecting while the other is non-balance affecting.

transaction_type.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a PayPal transaction event code. See Transaction event codes.

transaction_status.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a PayPal transaction status code. Value is:Status codeDescriptionDPayPal or merchant rules denied the transaction.PThe transaction is pending. The transaction was created but waits for another payment process to complete, such as an ACH transaction, before the status changes to S.SThe transaction successfully completed without a denial and after any pending statuses.VA successful transaction was reversed and funds were refunded to the original sender.

transaction_amount.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a gross transaction amount range. Specify the range as TO , where is the lower limit of the gross PayPal transaction amount and is the upper limit of the gross transaction amount. Specify the amounts in lower denominations. For example, to search for transactions from $5.00 to $10.05, specify [500 TO 1005].Note:The values must be URL encoded.

transaction_currency.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a three-character ISO-4217 currency code for the PayPal transaction currency.

payment_instrument_type.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a payment instrument type. Value is either:CREDITCARD. Returns a direct credit card transaction with a corresponding value.DEBITCARD. Returns a debit card transaction with a corresponding value.If you omit this parameter, the API does not apply this filter.

balance_affecting_records_only.description: Indicates whether the response includes only balance-impacting transactions or all transactions. Value is either:Y. The default. The response includes only balance transactions.N. The response includes all transactions.

terminal_id.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a terminal ID.

store_id.description: Filters the transactions in the response by a store ID.

page.description: The zero-relative start index of the entire list of items that are returned in the response. So, the combination of page=1 and page_size=20 returns the first 20 items.

page_size.description: The number of items to return in the response. So, the combination of page=1 and page_size=20 returns the first 20 items. The combination of page=2 and page_size=20 returns the next 20 items.

include_crypto_currencies.description: Indicates whether the response list balances including crypto transactions. Value is either:false. The default. The response doesn't include crypto transactions.true. The response also includes crypto transactions.

name: list_disputes
title: List disputes
description: View a list of customer complaints, chargebacks, or open cases. Use this to track buyer disputes and check their statuses.

start_time.description: Filters the disputes in the response by a creation date and time. The start time must be within the last 180 days. Value is in Internet date and time format. For example, *yyyy*-*MM*-*dd*T*HH*:*mm*:*ss*.*SSS*Z. You can specify either but not both the start_time and disputed_transaction_id query parameters.

disputed_transaction_id.description: Filters the disputes in the response by a transaction, by ID. You can specify either but not both the start_time and disputed_transaction_id query parameter.

page_size.description: Limits the number of disputes in the response to this value.

next_page_token.description: The token that describes the next page of results to fetch. The list disputes call returns this token in the HATEOAS links in the response.

dispute_state.description: Filters the disputes in the response by a state. Separate multiple values with a comma (,). When you specify more than one dispute_state, the response lists disputes that belong to any of the specified dispute_state.

update_time_before.description: The date and time when the dispute was last updated, in Internet date and time format. For example, *yyyy*-*MM*-*dd*T*HH*:*mm*:*ss*.*SSS*Z. update_time_before must be within the last 180 days and the default is the current time.

update_time_after.description: The date and time when the dispute was last updated, in Internet date and time format. For example, *yyyy*-*MM*-*dd*T*HH*:*mm*:*ss*.*SSS*Z. update_time_after must be within the last 180 days and the default is the maximum time (180 days) supported.

title: Upload document by verification token
description: Uploads required files like ID proof or business registration using a verification token to resolve account holds or failed identity checks. Use this when a managed account is pending verification and needs supporting paperwork.

token.description: Uploads a document, by verification token, which is the UUID of the build from the upstream business context. The value will be set from required_document of GET call response.

document_info.description: Document info of uploaded document. document_type is the only required field, the value of which will be mapped from name of required_document in GET call response. Here list the mapping relationship between name and document_type : **SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER** --> **SSN** **EMPLOYER_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER** --> **EIN** **BUSINESS_REGISTRATION_NUMBER** --> **BUSINESS_REGISTRATION** **TAX_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER** --> **TAX_ID** **NATIONAL_ID_NUMBER** --> **NATIONAL_ID** **BUSINESS_INCOME_TAX_RETURN** --> **TAX_RETURN_STATEMENT** VAT_ID --> VAT_ID PASSPORT --> PASSPORT DRIVERS_LICENSE --> DRIVERS_LICENSE CORPORATE_NUMBER --> CORPORATE_NUMBER CHARITY_NUMBER --> CHARITY_NUMBER BANK_STATEMENT --> BANK_STATEMENT

attachment.description: This is the actual document to be uploaded and the value should be file type. Need to upload document from local directory then manually trigger this API. To make document pass requirement and get approved automatically, the file name should contain approve key word, ex "proofOfSSNApprove"; to make document reject by system, the file name should contain reject key word, ex "proofOfSSNReject".
